title: Seven years with Amos Riley, then Buddy Petit's band
summary: Foster says he was with Amos Riley about seven years until Riley died, then joined Buddy Petit's band on drums, and names its members Chester Zardis, Manuel Gabriel, Louis Keppard and Isidore Fritz.
